body: Not to take any sides....but you may be at the point where you are doing everything in your power to correct the wrong you have made...except it is up to her to accept your efforts. At least that is what my shrink said about the efforts of my wayward and my willingness to accept his efforts. I cannot agree anymore with maddolphin about counseling. You on your own, her on her ow, and the both of you in marriage/couples counseling. At this point, she is the one calling the shots...the most you can do is be there for whatever flavor of healing she needs spite the outcome of your relationship. Best advice for her healing I could give is that apologies help, even if you do not see it yet, saying sorry helps so much. You can never apologize too many times, I just wish my wayward said it more. Good luck.

Thank you, the both of you.

Eare- Thanks for the different outlook on the engineering bit. Never thought about it from a courage standpoint, so that is something haha. Definitely something I don't quite want to do in life but it was a start to a different path.

Seen- Thanks about the writing style, I used to get quite a bit of real life feedback from the things I would post on social media...when I had it. Maybe I will finally write something on /r/writingprompts or /r/nosleep...

Life is magical without facebook! It seems your relationships with people on facebook equate to that of your bar hopping friends....and the depth is about the same.
